children: Investors await the Bank of England Decision Maker Panel data set to be released at 0830 GMT for clues on the possible inflationary impact of the U.S.-Iran conflict on U.K. businesses, RBC Capital Markets strategists say in a note. The Decision Maker Panel is a survey of chief financial officers from small, medium and large U.K. businesses on their views on inflation and wage growth. "The BOE's internal surveys are taking on greater importance in terms of its decision making," the strategists say. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
